Subject: Customer kickoff: proposed times + draft agenda (Brightside)

Hi Elena / Michael —

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier this week. We’ve put together the initial kickoff plan so we can lock a mutually convenient time and confirm owners for the bridge and runbook. Please find the draft agenda and attendee roster attached (kickoff-agenda-v1.pdf, attendee-roles.csv).

A few notes up front:
- Goal: align on roles, onboarding milestones for Sprints 0–1, and finalize production connectivity plan.
- Duration: 90 minutes (45m technical + 30m ops/contract Q&A + 15m action items)

Proposed kickoff windows (your local times shown):
- Option A: Mon, Nov 23 — 10:00–11:30 PT / 13:00–14:30 ET
- Option B: Mon, Nov 23 — 13:00–14:30 PT / 16:00–17:30 ET (later for US West)
- Option C: Tue, Nov 24 — 09:00–10:30 PT / 12:00–13:30 ET

Preliminary attendee list (please flag additions / approvers):
- Brightside: Elena Rios (Product Lead), Michael Wu (SRE), Procurement alias
- Redwood: Stephanie Nguyen (CS lead), Ben Carter (Implementation Engineer), Marissa Cole (Launch PM), Jonas Weber (Solutions Architecture)

Draft agenda highlights:
1) Welcome & objectives (5m)
2) Architecture walk — network/VPC/egress (20m)
3) Authentication & keying (KMS) + audit expectations (10m)
4) Data flows & retention / redaction policies (10m)
5) Roles and on-call / bridge ownership (15m)
6) Timeline & next steps (15m)
7) Procurement / billing touchpoints (10m)

Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/launch-brightside-20261123
Drive folder with assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bKickoffAssets

Can you confirm which option works for your team and whether anyone from legal/procurement will join for the billing block? If we don’t hear back by EOD Monday PT I’ll lock Option A and share the calendar invite.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
